cs.t: As somebody who bought an iPhone the day it became available and has been using iPhones for years, my favorite phone I've ever owned is my Huawei Mate XT Ultimate. People keep pretending that Chinese companies only make second-class copies of American products until it's too late.
cs.th: Kimi K3, Qwen 3.8, and Anthropic's (Potential) Unravelling

cs.t:
Why do almost all phones have to be in that narrow band of 6.1 to
6.9 inches? I wish there were more size choices on both ends of the spectrum.
While most people prefer more choice below 6", I would like more
choice above 7", since I keep my phone in my belly pouch, and never
use it one-handed. My current Huawei Mate20X is actually ok at 7.2"
(but worse than the Mediapad X1 I had before which at 7" was actually
wider) but is way behind on Android updates, and will soon stop running my
banking app.
I would have agreed with you until I saw the mate XT, now I want my phone-tablet-laptop. That's a future I'd enjoy.
cs.th: The death of industrial design and the era of dull electronics
